NRL Player Faces Judiciary Over Hip-Drop Tackle

Newcastle Knights player Jack Crossland has pleaded guilty and will face the NRL judiciary over a hip-drop tackle that resulted in Penrith Panthers player Nathan Cleary's leg being broken. The incident occurred during a match, leading to Crossland's referral to the judiciary.
